name: openkline
description: A framework-independent, extensible financial chart engine.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:core && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test test-dist/tests/core.test.js test-dist/tests/comparison.test.js test-dist/tests/comparison-datafeed.test.js test-dist/tests/datafeed.test.js test-dist/tests/datafeed-adapters.test.js test-dist/tests/series.test.js test-dist/tests/react.test.js test-dist/tests/indicators.test.js test-dist/tests/volume-analytics.test.js test-dist/tests/corporate-actions.test.js test-dist/tests/market-trades.test.js test-dist/tests/order-book.test.js test-dist/tests/multi-timeframe.test.js test-dist/tests/trading-calendar.test.js test-dist/tests/session-aggregation.test.js test-dist/tests/session-analytics-runtime.test.js test-dist/tests/session-visualization.test.js test-dist/tests/drawings.test.js test-dist/tests/plugins.test.js test-dist/tests/workspace.test.js test-dist/tests/studio-workspace.test.js test-dist/tests/synchronization.test.js test-dist/tests/strategies.test.js test-dist/tests/backtesting.test.js test-dist/tests/backtesting-worker.test.js test-dist/tests/portfolio-backtesting.test.js test-dist/tests/klinescript.test.js test-dist/tests/klinescript-fuzz.test.js test-dist/tests/klinescript-incremental.test.js test-dist/tests/klinescript-worker.test.js test-dist/tests/replay.test.js test-dist/tests/alerts.test.js test-dist/tests/paper-trading.test.js test-dist/tests/paper-trading-adapters.test.js test-dist/tests/optimization.test.js test-dist/tests/walk-forward.test.js test-dist/tests/screener-baseline.test.js test-dist/tests/screener-rules.test.js test-dist/tests/screener-snapshot.test.js test-dist/tests/screener-watch.test.js test-dist/tests/screener-worker.test.js test-dist/tests/public-api.test.js test-dist/tests/release-hardening.test.js test-dist/tests/functional-indicators-reference.test.js test-dist/tests/functional-datafeed-reliability.test.js test-dist/tests/phase-8-10-stress.test.js scripts/browser-evidence-validation.test.mjs scripts/api-compatibility-fixtures.test.mjs scripts/package-portability-policy.test.mjs
scripts.test:react:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.react.config.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:react:production: npm run build && npm --prefix examples/nextjs-app-router run build && playwright test --config playwright.react.production.config.ts --project=chromium-production
scripts.stress:ci: npm run build && OPENKLINE_STRESS_PROFILE=ci node --expose-gc scripts/phase-8-10-node-stress.mjs && OPENKLINE_STRESS_PROFILE=ci node --expose-gc scripts/phase-8-10-browser-stress.mjs
scripts.stress:local: npm run build && OPENKLINE_STRESS_PROFILE=local node --expose-gc scripts/phase-8-10-node-stress.mjs && OPENKLINE_STRESS_PROFILE=local node --expose-gc scripts/phase-8-10-browser-stress.mjs
scripts.stress:soak: npm run build && OPENKLINE_STRESS_PROFILE=soak node --expose-gc scripts/phase-8-10-node-stress.mjs && OPENKLINE_STRESS_PROFILE=soak node --expose-gc scripts/phase-8-10-browser-stress.mjs
scripts.package:check: npm run build && NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/openkline-npm-cache npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
scripts.preview:prepare: npm run build && node scripts/preview-candidate.mjs prepare
scripts.preview:verify: npm run build && node scripts/preview-candidate.mjs verify
